description: Read a bounded tail of a log on the selected Mac or a linked server. Secrets are removed before the text leaves the Mac.

lines.description: How many lines from the end. Default 200.

mac_id.description: Opaque id of one of this account's FrontierStack Macs. Optional only when exactly one Mac is online.

source.description: Which log: "os" (the system log), "wifi" (Wi-Fi events), a service name ("nginx", "apache", "mysql", "postgres", "redis", "sshd", "docker", "php-fpm", "postfix"), "vhost:example.com" for one website's access and error logs, "frontierstack" (the app's own log), or "path:/var/log/file.log".

target.description: Optional linked server, by the name or host FrontierStack knows it by, to run on over SSH. Omit for the selected Mac itself.

name: read_logs
title: Read scrubbed logs
